messages:
Priya: quick thought — prototype for playground streaming looks great visually but a couple UX questions: where does the token metric live when we collapse messages?
Owen: My vote: keep a tiny token badge in the message header (right side). If collapsed, show final count only. Avoid live-count spam.
Jules: Accessibility: SR users shouldn't hear every incremental token update. Use `aria-live=polite` for state-changes only: 'Generation started', 'Partial result available' and 'Generation complete — 98 tokens'.
Maya R: Agree. Also thinking about the interrupt affordance: per-message icon vs global stop. Per-message seems more intuitive for multi-turn sessions.
Ken: Implementation note: per-message cancel sends cancel RPC for that generation id. Make sure it doesn't cancel other queued requests in the same session.
Priya: Copy nit: button label proposals — "Stop", "Interrupt", "Abort". I think "Interrupt" is clearer that partial output stays.
Owen: +1 Interrupt. Add tooltip "Interrupt generation — partial output will remain" and keyboard shortcut `Ctrl+.` (or `Esc` as a secondary). Show shortcut hint in tooltip.
Jules: Color/contrast: current token badge uses a gray that fails 4.5:1 on light theme. Recommend darker bg or bold text.
Maya R: UX idea: add a microprogress indicator (thin bar under message) to give a sense of streaming without noisy token deltas. Could be purely visual and not announced.
Ken: Perf concern: updating DOM every chunk hurts composition and caret. Let's batch updates — 120ms window and only flush visible buffer to DOM. Also throttle token badge updates to 500ms.
Priya: Prompt Library addition: preference toggle "Show streaming preview" that is per-user and team-overridable. If off, the preview waits until generation ends.
Owen: Analytics: log `playground.preview_mode` (on/off), `interrupt_initiated`, `tokens_displayed_final`, `streaming_latency_ms`. Also record `preview_opt_out_reason` if user disables.
Jules: SR behavior: avoid `role=status` for constant updates. Use polite announcements on start/finish. If we provide partial result navigation ("View partial"), that action should be explicit so SR users can find it.
Maya R: Developers: please provide a simple ARIA spec in the PR: which elements get `aria-live`, what gets `aria-hidden`, any announcements.
Ken: I'll attach test harness measuring frame jank and layout shifts with streaming on.
Priya: One more UX point — regenerate should create a new message thread below (not replace) when used from playground. That way users can compare variants. Thoughts?
Owen: I like separate messages by default, with a compact "Compare" action that opens side-by-side in the prompt library.
Jules: Keyboard accessibility: interrupt must be tabbable and have clear focus indicator. Offer `aria-keyshortcuts=\"Ctrl+.\"` for supported browsers.
Maya R: Action items: Ken -> perf harness + 120ms batching prototype. Jules -> a11y spec + color contrast fixes. Owen -> analytics event list + UX copy for tooltip + shortcut. Priya -> update Figma flows for microprogress + token badge behavior and add prompt library toggle mock. I'll review tomorrow 10:30am PT.
Ken: On it. I'll drop results in this thread and tag @Maya R when done.
Priya: Thanks team — will ping if I need design feedback earlier.
